title: Sensex falls 210 points, Nifty closes below 24,650 as market snaps 4-day gaining streak - The Economic Times
text:
Indian benchmark indices ended lower on Tuesday, snapping a four-day winning streak amid volatility following the introduction of the new closing auction session framework. The Sensex dropped 210 points to close at 78,429, while the Nifty slipped 159 points to 24,615, reflecting stock-specific adjustments and mixed broader market performance.
